metadata.description: Collection of Claude Code plugins by ZaVang

plugins.name: claude-autoupdate
plugins.description: One-click Claude Code upgrade with automatic changelog summarization and core feature deep-dives

plugins.name: claude-init
plugins.description: One-click project initialization with CLAUDE.md templates, directory structure, and built-in agents

plugins.name: llm-bridge
plugins.description: Drop a production-ready LLM gateway into any Python project. Unified OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google Gemini/Vertex AI interface with structured output, retry, fallback, and key rotation.

plugins.name: harnesslib
plugins.description: Drop a production-ready agent harness into any Python project. Session/Harness/Sandbox/Orchestration framework inspired by Anthropic's Managed Agents — append-only session log, effect-loop harness, idempotent crash-replay, and multi-process-safe SQLite persistence. Pairs with llm-bridge.

plugins.name: project-chronicle
plugins.description: Auto-generate a development log for your project. Run /chronicle at the end of each session to append a timestamped summary to docs/chronicle.md — capturing steps, tools, skills, and outcomes across multiple sessions.

plugins.name: multi-ralph
plugins.description: Multi-agent Sprint execution loop with Planner, Generator, and Evaluator subagents. File-isolated context, pitfalls knowledge-base, iterative verification.

plugins.name: product-loop
plugins.description: Unified two-tier iteration engine: Reviewer -> Scout -> Planner -> Generator -> Evaluator. --tier1 toggles auto product-critique (on) vs human-written SPRINT as source (off = multi-ralph behavior); Scout grounds the code before planning; termination follows --tier1.

plugins.name: email-mailbox
plugins.description: Two-way email mailbox for Claude Code — send via SMTP, receive/read/search/monitor via IMAP
